case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70530.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your renewal offer and for explaining the component, copper and labour cost pressures. We recognise those pressures and your head-office pricing constraints, and value your defect-free quality.

Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 84.6% (sc:70530@2026Q3).

Our proposal offers longer account continuity and a defined annual requirement to support planning, alongside our request for improved commercial terms and delivery recovery. We are flexible on payment terms, including retaining your offered term; which package works best within your approval process?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 419.43 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, 4,580 units per year.
Option B: EUR 414.56 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, 4,580 units per year.
Option C: EUR 415.73 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, 4,580 units per year.

We appreciate your help in establishing a dependable basis for the renewed agreement.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your verified delivery data and are implementing measures to ensure our usual high standards. 

As to the delivery record data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. 

While our head office has frozen base price reductions, we can offer a concession in exchange for the extended 24-month contract term. 

Our Angebot is a price of €433.08 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Building on your Option B, we propose a revised price of €430.15 per unit for a 24-month agreement with 30 days net payment, with a price of €430.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

Thank you for the concession linked to an extended agreement and for acting on the delivery findings. We recognise that your head-office pricing rules and rising input costs make a terms-based package the practical route forward.

Our modest adjustment offers defined annual volume and account continuity to support planning, and we ask for a further step from you in return. We are flexible on contract length: Option A provides the extended term you requested, while Option B offers longer continuity; which works best within your approval process?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 429.90 per unit, 24-month agreement, payment 90 days net, 4,580 units per year.
Option B: EUR 429.90 per unit, 36-month agreement, payment 90 days net, 4,580 units per year.

We appreciate your constructive approach and believe we are close, with Option B offering a strong basis for agreement.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

We are making a modest step and ask you to reciprocate, with annual volume visibility and continuity supporting your planning. We are flexible on contract length: Option B provides the longer agreement you welcomed; which option works best within your approval process?

Option B: EUR 431.76 per unit, 36-month agreement, payment 90 days net, 4,580 units per year.

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have already taken that quality record data into account. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION.

Our baseline proposal stands at a price of €433.08 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Due to our strict internal price freeze, we cannot reduce the price further under a 90-day payment term. 

We are pleased to align with your preference for a 36-month agreement to ensure long-term continuity. However, by adjusting the payment term to 30 days, we can offer you a reduced price of €430.15 per unit. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 36 months: €430.15 per unit.

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
